name: Ca tre nuong
summary: Cá trê nướng is grilled catfish. The conservation page names it among things that have drawn visitors to Vân Long. It is not the same sentence as cá chuối nướng.
origin: Vân Long. The conservation page places the wetland in huyện Gia Viễn. The tourism page says xã Gia Vân. Both stay.
howToEat: The conservation page names the fish and does not print a garnish. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca tre nuong — catfish at Van Long
seoDescription: Grilled catfish named on the Vân Long conservation page, kept separate from cá chuối nướng.
